Try this...

(DEFUN DPL? (X)
  (IF (ATOM X) ()
    (DO ((L  (CDR X) (CDR L))
	 (FLAG NIL)
	 (LL (CDR X) (CDDR LL)))
	((NULL LL) T)
      (IF (OR (ATOM LL) (ATOM (CDR LL)))
	  (RETURN NIL) ; bad format
	(IF FLAG (IF (EQ L LL) (RETURN NIL)) ;circular
	  (SETQ FLAG T))))))
